api_key.description: Phare API key for authentication. Can also be set via PHARE_API_KEY environment variable.

base_url.description: Phare API base URL. Defaults to https://api.phare.io. Can be overridden via PHARE_BASE_URL environment variable for testing.

project_scope.description: Optional. Project scope for API requests when using an organization-scoped API key. Accepts either a numeric project ID (e.g., 123) or a string project slug (e.g., "my-project"). Can also be set via PHARE_PROJECT_ID or PHARE_PROJECT_SLUG environment variables.

timeout.description: HTTP client timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.

block.description: Terraform provider for managing Phare uptime monitoring resources.

event.description: Name of the event that will trigger the alert rule, [see docs](https://docs.phare.io/uptime/alerting#events)

event_settings.description: Additional settings for the event (JSON object as string)

integration_id.description: The ID of the integration used to send notifications

rate_limit.description: Minimum time in minutes between alert executions

scope.description: Scope of the alert rule. Must be either 'organization' or 'project'. When set to 'project', the alert rule is scoped to the project specified by project_scope or the provider-level project. When set to 'organization', the alert rule applies to the entire organization.

block.description: Manages an alert rule in Phare. Alert rules define conditions that trigger notifications when events occur.

members.description: List of team member IDs (1-100 members)

use_incident_ai.description: Whether to generate AI summaries for incidents. Defaults to true.

use_incident_merging.description: Whether to use incident merging. Defaults to true.
